findings.title: Latest-request ownership in shared table loader
findings.before: Aborting alone did not prevent a slow adapter from committing stale rows/errors, and a delayed debounced callback could run after unmount.
findings.change: Snapshot params, disposed guard, AbortController ownership before commits and error propagation; page handlers return the load promise.

findings.title: Batch image access cache/session and paginated lookup ownership
findings.before: Shared privilege/access cache was not bound to login generation; an old pagination/finalizer could continue or replace newer state. This UI gate is not a replacement for backend authorization.
findings.change: Session-stamped cache, login notifications, per-lookup generation, assertions around each page, finite page count and shared in-flight force refresh.

findings.title: Public settings could close the inline development script element
findings.before: Raw JSON.stringify interpolation admitted a literal </script> sequence from a malicious string in public settings. Exploit requires control of such settings delivered to the development server.
findings.change: Escape HTML-significant characters and U+2028/U+2029 before interpolation; DOMParser regression verifies exactly one script and lossless JSON roundtrip.
findings.limitation: Production backend HTML injection is not present in this repository and is not verified by this fix.

findings.title: Optional spreadsheet/payment SDKs forced into common vendor chunks
findings.before: The manualChunks rules placed XLSX in vendor-ui and Airwallex in vendor-misc despite their dynamic usage. Unrelated routes downloaded these packages in their static import graph.
findings.change: Dedicated vendor-xlsx and vendor-airwallex chunks preserve deferred loading.
findings.measurement: Same Vite 5.4.21 build-tool comparison retained; static import graph, not browser/network latency or TPS.

findings.title: Account automatic refresh can replace a completed newer search
findings.before: Automatic ETag response lacked page/filter/generation ownership; async initialization could install global listeners after unmount.
findings.change: Abort and generation invalidation, captured page/filter context, current-operation finalizer, disposed checks for usage batches and startup.

findings.title: Stripe popup bypassed shared client and accepted unrelated same-origin messages
findings.before: Status fetch read bearer storage itself, asynchronous SDK/poll work could continue after exit, and INIT checked origin without validating opener/type.
findings.change: Shared paymentAPI; opener, schema and order validation; captured auth session; single-flight polling; post-await guards; tracked close timer.

findings.title: Stripe payment slow polls overlap
findings.change: Single in-flight status request, post-await disposed checks, terminal failed/cancelled/expired stop polling.

findings.title: Payment components allow stale order completion/cancel/verification
findings.before: Clearing timers alone did not invalidate pending get/verify/cancel results. Slow dialog polls overlapped, old orders could emit success for replacement orders, and expired UI could continue polling.
findings.change: Order/session/generation ownership; single-flight through get and verify; suppress stale cancel completion; expired initialization creates no poll; QR/deep-link callbacks observe operation lifetime.
findings.limitation: No payment-provider end-to-end charge or settlement was performed; server billing remains unchanged.

findings.title: Step-up callback can replay after authentication session replacement
findings.before: A pending TOTP confirmation was not bound to login generation or component scope; it could replay under a replacement login or hang after navigation.
findings.change: Captured auth session and tracked cancellation, checks before/after each asynchronous boundary; scope disposal settles the prompt; prevents stale action replay.
findings.limitation: This fixes frontend replay ownership; server enforcement of step-up remains outside available backend source.

findings.title: Monitoring tabs commit obsolete filter/tab results and restart after exit
findings.change: Independent tab AbortController, filter snapshot, tab/sequence/controller ownership, stale error suppression, and disposed checks across dimensions/metrics/timer creation.

findings.title: Backup/restore status polling overlaps and notifies after navigation
findings.change: One in-flight request per active poll; AbortController ownership across visibility restart, completion and unmount; latest-list ownership; compatible optional signals on two GET helpers. The restore POST and password semantics are unchanged.

findings.title: Batch image preview/job lifecycle needs a dedicated follow-up
findings.details: Selected job/details and preview hydration lack one shared operation generation. IndexedDB thumbnails use a shared database and a batch/custom/image key without an explicit user namespace, and late preview hydration can create Blob URLs after teardown.
findings.recommendation: Bind job/preview work to auth generation and selected batch, introduce per-user cache namespace and logout/retention policy, invalidate queued tasks before cleanup, and test ignored-abort/IndexedDB races.
findings.limitation: This is a code-level follow-up, not a demonstrated unauthorized server-data disclosure; backend ID uniqueness/authorization and actual shared-device privacy policy were not available. Parent intentionally deferred broad changes.

findings.title: Large administrator/page components remain costly to maintain and load
findings.details: Settings and Groups contain many thousands of source lines, Accounts retains a large generated route chunk. Domain/modal-level asynchronous decomposition and state ownership need incremental integration tests. The route prefetch adjacency also schedules neighboring routes during idle time without an explicit saveData/slow-network budget; a real browser waterfall is needed before describing static graph totals as actual bytes downloaded.
findings.limitation: A large source file alone is not a measured rendering bottleneck; no production flamegraph, browser INP/LCP, CPU budget or realistic large-data profile was available.

baseline_new_regressions.notes: The first StripePopup run failed to collect due to a test mock; a corrected isolated run produced 3 assertion failures. Initial StepUp run had an incompatible worker configuration and no tests; rerun with minWorkers/maxWorkers=1 produced 1 assertion failure and 2 hung-scope timeouts. Only real corrected failures count.

eslint.result: passed for changed sections (earlier payment/table/cache/vite gates; latest StepUp/monitor/backup/API gate)

production_build_before_after.method: Union of index.html and requested route static manifest imports; excludes dynamicImports, CSS/images, HTTP headers and transport timing. gzip bytes use Python gzip.compress with mtime=0.
production_build_before_after.caveat: These intermediate snapshots were built using the same Vite 5.4.21 version while parallel agents edited application source. Retained only for explaining vendor splitting, not a pure original-release baseline or isolated causal experiment. Use original_release_comparison for exact tracked release source versus candidate. Existing idle route prefetch and dynamic imports are excluded.

final_upgraded_build.large_chunk_warning: AccountsView ~857 KB and vendor-xlsx ~500 KB minified remain; warning not suppressed.
final_upgraded_build.optional_chunk_boundary_check: XLSX/Airwallex/Stripe absent from static index/Login/Dashboard/admin Usage graphs.
final_upgraded_build.caveat: This final build uses upgraded dependencies and all agents changes; it is acceptance evidence, not the same-toolchain causal experiment. Existing idle route prefetch and dynamic imports are excluded from static route totals.

cross_review.mode: Read-only focused diff and ownership review for auth agent.
cross_review.result: No new issue found in one-entry digest cache or draft replacement/TTL ownership; reported remaining page-disposal guards across RegisterView action proof and EmailVerifyView post-registration navigation to owning agent. Owning agent confirmed added disposal guards and 6 passing regressions; final auth code frozen before final build.

limitations: The complete backend/server implementation is absent, so upstream scheduling/rate limits/SQL/Redis/billing/authorization are not audited by this frontend work.
No live network/backend TPS, p50/p95 latency, provider integration charge, browser LCP/INP or realistic memory profile was measured.
Structural inventory is not equivalent to reading and proving every line. See per-file review_mode.
No deployment, production-data mutation, push, PR, API route/role/billing/feature-flag behavior change by this agent.
BatchImageGuide lifecycle/cache namespace and broad architecture decomposition are recorded follow-ups, not claimed resolved.
